context.description: A gap in the generated rows fails the structural totality check before any run (owner ruling 4)

evidence.trustReason: Fresh-context review of packages/opencode/test/task/verify-spec-RM29.spec.ts (7 tests, re-run: 7 pass, 0 fail, 921 expect calls; the committed file's sha256 equals the adapter run 20261016T145852Z-d44dfa hash). Given: test 1 copies TaskMachine.config of the loaded release-notes plan with mapStates and removes exactly one row from T1_5/waiting; it asserts the removed original row targets blocked with the block action {unit T1.5, from waiting, id T1.4, state budget_exhausted}. When/Then: TaskMachine.check(plan, copy) and fromConfig throw 'totality: T1.5 waiting has no row for T1.4 budget_exhausted' (the line tasks.md pins); the message contains T1.5, waiting and T1.4 budget_exhausted; no machine exists; the original config passes. Test 2 shows what the check prevents: the copy built by the port alone leaves T1.5 waiting on an ended T1.4, while the real machine blocks it. And every real plan passes: test 3 loads every task-formats/blend folder that the loader accepts (exactly the five), whole and as each task subtree, asserts check and machine(plan) pass, and an independent plain-data oracle finds in each waiting/ready state a blocked row with the block action for every task dependency x every blocking final state, the ready row on all trusted, and the parked row for an outside need; the oracle flags the removed row (positive control). Test 4 folds each T1.4 end (needs_human, budget_exhausted, failed, blocked) and gets T1.5 blocked by T1.4 with that state. And no stuck state / settle: test 5 has the scan refuse a non-final state with no rows, run running and run waiting with no settle row, and S13 waiting without the parked row, and finds no non-final task/scenario/run node without a row in any real plan; test 6 walks 6 real plans x 12 seeds through apply: while active never all regions final, a done run has all regions final, every standstill is a transitive wait on an untrusted outside/external region, outcomes reach done, failed, cancelled and a dead state; the same check flags the gap copy's stuck T1.5. Test 7: T1.5 waits on T9, and in its subtree on external T1.3 and T1.4, until outside.trusted moves it to ready. No mock of the unit under test. No gap.
